vision: To emerge as a premier center of technical excellence in higher education by imparting quality engineering and management education, fostering innovative research, and nurturing socially responsible, ethically grounded global professionals.
mission: To provide student-centric, outcome-based engineering and management education with state-of-the-art infrastructure and industry-aligned curricula.
To foster a culture of cutting-edge research, innovation, entrepreneurship, and continuous learning among faculty and students.
To establish strong collaborative partnerships with global industries, premier academic institutions, and research organizations.
To instill ethical values, leadership qualities, environmental consciousness, and social responsibility for sustainable nation building.
